storage.unavailable: Persistent storage is unavailable. Changes will be lost when you close the app.
storage.recordsSkipped: Some records could not be read and were skipped. They are still in the file you can export.

task.name: Name
task.title: Task
task.empty: No tasks yet. Add the first one.

form.wholeNumberFrom: Enter a whole number, {min} or more

backup.title: Backup
backup.confirmBody: Records in the file: {incoming}. Records to be deleted: {current}. This cannot be undone.
backup.restoreFailed: Could not restore from the file: {reason}

mockData.title: Sample data
mockData.confirmBody: This replaces every dream, goal, group and task currently in the app ({current} records total) with freshly generated sample data. Settings are not affected. This cannot be undone.

sync.title: Sync
sync.scanning: Point the camera at the code
sync.orPaste: No camera? Paste the code here
sync.cameraFailed: The camera is unavailable. Paste the code instead.

server.intro: Sync this device with your workspace-server — a small program on your computer that keeps your data and passes changes between your devices.
server.pairHint: On the server's page, press “Pair a device”, then scan its code here or paste it.

state.paused: Sync paused: {reason}. It will try again on its own.
state.blocked: Sync paused: the server refuses this device for a few minutes after too many failed attempts. It will try again on its own.

server.unreachableHint: Check that the server is running and that this device is on the same network. If the server's data was deleted or its port changed, disconnect and pair again with a new code.

relay.title: Pair another device
relay.intro: On the server's page, press “Pair a device”, then scan its code here. This device only shows the code again for the other one: its own pairing stays as it is.
relay.ready: The code for {name} is ready. Show it to the other device.
relay.show: On the other device, open the Sync page and point its camera at this code, or send the code there and paste it.
relay.expiry: The code works once, within 10 minutes of being made on the server's page.
relay.foreign: This code is for the server {name}, not the one this device syncs with. The other device will sync with {name}.
relay.copied: Code copied. Paste it on the other device.
relay.copyFailed: Could not copy the code. Show it to the other device's camera instead.
relay.shareFailed: Could not share the code. Copy it or show it to the other device's camera instead.

settings.cleanupDaysHint: Shortening this deletes older closed items and completion history sooner.
settings.accentHint: Each colour is drawn lighter or darker where needed, so that text stays readable.

entity.name: Name
entity.cascadeDreamBody: Active goals under this dream: {goals}. Active tasks under them: {tasks}.
entity.colorHint: Each colour is drawn lighter or darker where needed, so that text stays readable.

backup.notBackup: it does not contain a backup
backup.wrongVersion: it is backup version {found}, and this app reads version {expected} only
backup.noItems: the backup has no list of records
backup.badItem: record {number} in the file is damaged
backup.duplicateId: record {number} repeats the id of another one
backup.badSettings: the settings in the file are damaged

server.notPairingCode: this is not a workspace-server pairing code
server.tooNew: the code comes from a newer server than this app understands. Update the app
server.connectTimeout: the server did not answer. Check that it runs and that both devices are on the same network
server.closed: the connection to the server closed
server.protocol: the server speaks a different protocol version. Update the app or the server
server.unknownApp: this server does not serve this app. Add it on the server's Apps page
server.badSecret: the code has expired or was already used. Make a new one on the server's page
server.badToken: the server no longer knows this device. Pair it again
server.blocked: too many failed attempts from this device. Wait a few minutes and try again
server.serverChanged: this is a different server than the one this device was paired with. Pair again
server.tooLarge: the data is larger than the server accepts
server.notJson: the server refused the data as damaged
server.newerSchema: the server holds data from a newer version of the app. Update this one
server.badDocument: the data on the server cannot be read. Nothing was overwritten
server.tooManyWrites: it wrote too many times in a row. Reopen the app
server.conflict: another device kept changing the data. Try again
